title: Czechia Tears Up Its Fiscal Rulebook · 28 Aug
keywords: Czechia, Czech fiscal rules, Czech parliament, budget deficit, debt-financed investment, Petr Pavel, Czech National Bank, EU fiscal framework, infrastructure spending, defence spending, European fiscal policy, Czech politics, sovereign debt
notes: Czech lawmakers have overridden a presidential veto to pass legislation loosening the country's budget rules, clearing the way for larger state deficits and debt-financed investment in infrastructure, energy, and defence. The move has split the political establishment and drawn sharp criticism from President Petr Pavel, who warned that the changes threaten long-term fiscal sustainability. The debate places Czechia at the centre of a wider European argument over whether governments can responsibly loosen fiscal constraints to fund growth without eroding hard-won credibility.
